description: This source file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface within the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically for configuring in-memory streaming capabilities with customizable serializers.

classes.name: SiloBuilderMemoryStreamExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure in-memory streams on the Orleans ISiloBuilder.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStreamConfigurator<TSerializer>
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring memory streams with a specific serializer type (implied from usage in the extension methods).

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Extension method to add memory streams to the silo builder using the default serializer (DefaultMemoryMessageBodySerializer).

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams<TSerializer>
methods.description: Generic extension method to add memory streams with a specified serializer type that implements IMemoryMessageBodySerializer.
